n=992 repositories, 295 archived (29.7%). AUC is meaningful on this base rate.
5-fold CV, seed 20260806, identical folds for all three: {'product': 0.4855, 'additive': 0.653, 'saturated': 0.7023}. This gate is about REPORTING, not about the product winning.

F7 FIRED. product - additive = -0.1675; product - saturated = -0.2168; margin 0.01 fixed before the run and NOT moved after seeing these. The product specification scores 0.4855, which is at chance -- it loses to both rivals, in the wrong direction, by more than an order of magnitude beyond the margin.

seven families declared: {'T1_substrate_P1': 'DATA_ABSENT', 'T2_bend_vs_stagger_P2': 'DATA_ABSENT', 'T3_circulation_P3': 'DATA_ABSENT', 'T4_hardship_branch_P4': 'DATA_ABSENT', 'T5_tether_P5': 'DATA_ABSENT', 'B_the_ABM': 'NOT_BUILT_BY_CHOICE', 'D_the_pilot': 'CANNOT_RUN'}. Each names the artefact that would unblock it. None is reported as pending or partially complete. The ABM was buildable and deliberately NOT built -- it calibrates to T1/T5 moments that do not exist, so building it would have produced impressive numbers calibrated to nothing.

The bench specified SME/mortgage loan panels; none exist here and outbound fetch is policy-blocked, so 992 GitHub repositories were substituted. This appears in the primary verdict, not only in the spec.

T1_substrate_P1.needs: FDIC failed-bank files + Call Reports (2007-09, 2020, 2023) and stablecoin depeg on-chain flows. None committed; api.github.com returns 403 and outbound fetch is policy-blocked.

T2_bend_vs_stagger_P2.needs: loss/outflow distributions for fixed-claim books vs coupled books under common shocks, for the dip-test and the regression-discontinuity. The three committed contract panels are 10 accounts each with no outflow series and no common shock, which is nowhere near a dip-test.

T3_circulation_P3.needs: negative-rate / carry-cost episodes with holdings concentration series, or published ROSCA member-shock trials. Neither committed.

T4_hardship_branch_P4.needs: HAMP or comparable modification evaluations with downstream-counterparty distress within 12 months. The committed panels carry default flags and recovery but NO counterparty graph, so cascade size is undefined on them.

T5_tether_P5.needs: asset panels with claim-growth and real-cashflow-growth series (US housing 2000-08, equities margin vs dividends, crypto 2020-22, CRE 2021-24). None committed.

B_the_ABM.reason: It is buildable here and was deliberately not built. The bench itself says the ABM is 'not evidence about the world', and it is calibrated to T1/T5 moments AFTER those publish -- which they cannot, since T1 and T5 are DATA_ABSENT. Building it now would produce impressive numbers calibrated to nothing, and the simulator rule in this repository forbids treating that as evidence. It is deferred, not skipped.

D_the_pilot.reason: A 24-month sandbox cooperative with ~200 members and two interim looks. No amount of compute substitutes for elapsed time and real members.

primary_verdict: 6/6. The full eight-falsifier bench is LOCKED; exactly ONE family could be executed. T0 ran and F7 FIRED. The independence gate passed first on features alone (VIF {'logU': 1.269, 'D_enc': 1.055, 'D_dec': 1.231}, all under 5), the outcome is well populated (295 of 992 archived), and on identical folds the product specification U*D_enc*D_dec scored 0.4855 -- AT CHANCE -- against additive 0.6530 and saturated 0.7023. It loses by -0.1675 and -0.2168 against a pre-registered margin of 0.01 that was not moved afterwards. The multiplicative axiom A2 is DISCONFIRMED on this cohort. DOMAIN SUBSTITUTION: the bench specified SME/mortgage loan panels; none exist here and outbound fetch is policy-blocked, so 992 GitHub repositories were used instead. This is the home ground where E = U*D_enc*D_dec was defined, which makes it a friendly test rather than a hostile one -- but it settles NOTHING about lending, and a defender saying 'repos are not loans' is right. The other seven families are DATA_ABSENT, NOT_BUILT_BY_CHOICE or CANNOT_RUN, each naming what would unblock it; none is dressed up as pending.
